Health Functional FoodNiacin 15mgMilk thistle 130mgVitamin B1 1.2mgVitamin B12 0.72μgVitamin B2 1.4mgVitamin B6 0.45mgFolate 120μgOnce a day

레비큐골드Niacin · Milk thistle · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate

Made by 주)팜크로스 · Once a day · 2 capsules

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 130mg of Milk thistle, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 0.72μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 0.45mg of Vitamin B6, 120μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 capsules): 15mg Niacin, 130mg Milk thistle, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 0.72μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 0.45mg Vitamin B6, 120μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주)팜크로스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Milk thistle
    • May help with liver health
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 capsules per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (15mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Milk thistle labelled (130mg / 1000mg), 80~120%
Vitamin B1 labelled (1.2mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (0.72μg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (1.4mg / 1000mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.45mg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (120μg / 1000mg), 80~150%
Appearance 이미, 이취가 없고 고유의 향미가 있는 황색의 분말을 함유한 담갈색의 경질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 수분, 열에 의해 품질에 영향을 받을 수 있으므로 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하시고 제품 개봉 후에는 흡습되지 않게 밀봉하여 보관하십시오. 제품의 향미에 영향을 줄 수 있는 다른 식품, 식품첨가물과는 분리 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Milk thistle · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product
